row.notes: Gets the CareerTime and Schedule components from the career object ([vm+0x630]+0x88,+0x260), clears the two item lists vm+0x6a0 and vm+0x6e0 and their nodes vm+0x6c8 and vm+0x708, reads the 1-based season from the int node vm+0x648 and converts that season's start and end minutes to days (>>5, /45). Pass 1 walks timeline entries of kind 2 (Career_Timeline_FindEntryFromDay) and for each new day adds an item under vm+0x6c8 with index, start day, end day, midpoint, season start and season end, pushed to vm+0x6a0. Pass 2 does the same for entries of kind 0xc and 0xb (merged when they overlap) under vm+0x708, pushed to vm+0x6e0. Context from caller: Vm_FinanceHistoryGraph_Bind 0x141ef4ff0 binds contract_periods and season_breaks lists; caller 0x141ef5d20: sets the selected season index and can-toggle flags, calls this, then dispatches a UI event.
